result.title: SAGE: Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts for Point Cloud Registration
result.summary: Point cloud registration is an essential task for scene reconstruction, requiring the alignment of partially overlapping point clouds. Under low-overlap conditions, this task remains challenging because existing geometry-only methods cannot distinguish geometrically similar but semantically distinct structures (e.g., TV corners vs. desk corners and chair legs vs. table legs), resulting in incorrect correspondences. To address this geometric ambiguity, we present Semantic-Augmented Geometric Experts (SAGE), which integrates frozen pre-trained point cloud semantic representations into the registration pipeline without requiring additional sensors or fine-tuning the semantic encoder. To effectively leverage these semantic distinctions, SAGE employs a Semantic-Guided Mixture of Experts (SG-MoE) architecture. Through semantic-aware routing, SG-MoE enables each expert to specialize in distinct semantic-geometric patterns, reducing mismatches that confound geometry-only methods. With a structure-aware estimator, SAGE achieves the highest registration recall on 3DLoMatch while remaining competitive on 3DMatch. When evaluated with the same number of refinement iterations, SAGE further achieves the highest inlier ratio and registration recall on both benchmarks. These results indicate that frozen semantic representations provide effective cues for resolving geometric ambiguity in low-overlap registration.

AI.brief_summary: 针对低重叠点云配准中几何相似但语义不同结构导致的错误对应，SAGE 将冻结的预训练点云语义表示接入配准流程，并用语义引导的 MoE 路由让各专家专注不同的语义-几何模式，同时配合结构感知估计器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用冻结外部语义表示消除几何歧义 + 语义驱动的专家路由」可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与专家/子状态路由提供方法线索，但该工作属 3D 配准，与推理状态生成无直接关系，需核查路由机制是否可迁移。
